result.summary: The page renders mostly correctly, but the 'Fastest near you' carousel contains a duplicated restaurant entry, and the favorite (heart) buttons across restaurant cards use inconsistent styling.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' carousel shows 'Green Bowl Poké' twice as the first two cards, with identical images, delivery time (15–25 min) and fee (€0.90 delivery), which looks like a data duplication bug.
issues.suggestion: De-duplicate the restaurant list by unique ID before rendering the carousel, or show a different nearby restaurant in the second slot.

issues.description: The favorite heart buttons are styled inconsistently: the one on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card has a white circular background with a dark outline heart, while the one on the pizza card below has a dark/transparent circular background with a white heart.
issues.suggestion: Use a single consistent favorite-button style (same background, icon color and opacity) across all restaurant cards, ensuring adequate contrast over any image.
